ctx.x: what have you. Tommy Miles' band had... What they did actually... Like, in mostly governmental things that don't run quite true to what they're supposed to be. The guys who headed the Arts things in the WPA came up and recruited Tommy Miles' whole band, because he wanted to make his project look good, you know. And doing that, there again, somebody sought me out to join this thing and play with the band.

Meanwhile, I had this young family and everything. They said there was regular money and it meant that we played a minimum of twice a week... We played places like the hospitals, we played St. Louis Elizabeth Hospital every Tuesday. We played schools and all sorts of government places. And what we did every day was rehearse. So this is where I really had a chance to stretch out my arranging and everything. Before that, I had written this little thing that my band had been playing. I don't know what we called it,…
